query: PCB prepreg materials United States tariff classification

statements.text:
Colored Fiberglass Printed Circuit Board Prepreg
Pre-impregnated mechanically bonded fabric of colored glass fiber rovings used as substrate in PCB manufacturing before resin curing. HTS 7019.62.90 covers this as colored closed roving fabric, excluding fully cured composites.
